description.zh:
API资源标识符，API的全局唯一标识。 调用**CreateDataAPIService**接口成功创建API，返回的ApiSrn值。

格式：`acs:iot:*:${aliyunuserID}:serveapi/${ApiPath}`

示例：`acs:iot:*:127103983461****:serveapi/device/getDeviceCountByStatus2`

以上示例中的信息说明如下：

- `127103983461****`是阿里云主账号ID。
- `/device/getDeviceCountByStatus`是请求参数ApiPath的值，即API调用地址的自定义部分。
description.en:
API resource identifier, which is the global unique identity of the API. This value is returned as **ApiSrn** after you successfully create an API by invoking the **CreateDataAPIService** API.  

Format: `acs:iot:*:${aliyunuserID}:serveapi/${ApiPath}`  

Example: `acs:iot:*:127103983461****:serveapi/device/getDeviceCountByStatus2`  

The information in the preceding example is described as follows:  

- `127103983461****` is the Alibaba Cloud account ID.  
- `/device/getDeviceCountByStatus` is the value of the request parameter **ApiPath**, which represents the custom part of the API invocation path.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: Instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances. For Enterprise instances, you must specify this parameter.

description.zh:
ARRAY类型的参数值的数据类型。请参见[JDBCType](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/sql/JDBCType.html)。
目前仅支持VARCHAR、INTEGER、BIGINT、BOOLEAN、DECIMAL、TIMESTAMP。
description.en:
The data type of the parameter value for an ARRAY-type parameter. See [JDBCType](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/sql/JDBCType.html).  
Currently, only VARCHAR, INTEGER, BIGINT, BOOLEAN, DECIMAL, and TIMESTAMP are supported.

description.zh:
ARRAY类型的参数值列表。数组中只能放置一组类型相同的数据，例如放置数值类型数据，则全部数据为数值类型。

> 统一使用String类型存储，平台会跟据ListParamType对应的值转换成JDBC类型对象。
description.en:
List of parameter values of the ARRAY type. The array can contain only one group of data with the same type. For example, if numeric data is included, all elements in the array must be numeric.  

> All values are stored as strings. The platform transforms them into Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) type objects based on the corresponding value of **ListParamType**.

description.zh: 调用API的入参参数名称。必须与调用**CreateDataAPIService**接口创建API时，**RequestParam**中定义的**Name**保持一致。
description.en: The input parameter name for invoking the API. It must exactly match the **Name** defined in **RequestParam** when the API was created by calling the **CreateDataAPIService** API.

description.zh:
数据类型。目前只支持VARCHAR、INTEGER、BOOLEAN、BIGING、TIMESTAMP、DECIMAL和ARRAY类型。

> 当paramType选择ARRAY时，ListParamType和ListParamValue参数会生效；paramType为其他类型时，paramValue参数会生效。
description.en:
Data type. Currently, only VARCHAR, INTEGER, BOOLEAN, BIGINT, TIMESTAMP, DECIMAL, and ARRAY types are supported.  

> When **ParamType** is set to ARRAY, the **ListParamType** and **ListParamValue** parameters take effect. For all other **ParamType** values, the **ParamValue** parameter takes effect.

description.zh:
调用API的入参参数值。

- 统一使用String类型存储，物联网平台会根据创建API时定义的**ParamType**转换成JDBC类型对象。

- 创建API时，如果API请求参数类型**Type**定义为ARRAY类型，则不传入该参数，而需传入**ListParamType**和**ListParamValue**。
description.en:
The input parameter value for invoking the API.  

- All values are stored as strings. The IoT Platform converts them into JDBC type objects based on the **ParamType** defined when the API was created.  

- If the API request parameter **Type** is defined as ARRAY when creating the API, do not pass this parameter. Instead, pass **ListParamType** and **ListParamValue**.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为1。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Condition  
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account when calling this API is 1.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.legacyCli: aliyun iot InvokeDataAPIService --region cn-hangzhou --Param.1.ListParamValue.1 'example-string' --ApiSrn 'acs:iot:0:1271039834610000:serveapi/device/getDeviceCountByStatus2' --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --Param.1.ParamName status --Param.1.ParamType VARCHAR --Param.1.ListParamType VARCHAR --Param.1.ParamValue 1
